entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
You
took
your
sweet
time![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_01

entries.text: We wanted to talk to you before Kiki wakes up.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_02

entries.text: I wanted to fix dear Ogerpon’s mask, but...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_gfather_01

entries.text: I’ll need one more material if I want to do a\nproper job of it.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_gfather_02

entries.text: According to Grandpa, we need to get a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Crystal[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Cluster[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the bottom of the Crystal Pool.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_04

entries.text: I mean, we COULD just return the mask as it is.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_05

entries.text: But I think it would make Ogerpon real happy if\nwe fixed it up first![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_06

entries.text: Yeah, I bet it would!
entries.label: sdc01_0290_select_01

entries.text: That’s a nice thing to do
entries.label: sdc01_0290_select_02

entries.text: Especially now that I’ve heard the real story...\nI just want Ogerpon to be happy, you know?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_07

entries.text: I’m sure Ogerpon will be pleased to know you\ncare so much for it.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_gfather_03

entries.text: Mornin’, Grandpa.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_brother_01

entries.text: Ah, good morning, Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_gfather_04

entries.text: Kiki! You’d better go kill time somewhere—[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_09

entries.text: Yeah, yeah. Do whatever you want, Sis.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_brother_02

entries.text: E-excuse me?! I don’t need that kinda attitude\nfrom you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_10

entries.text: I got stuff to do, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_brother_03

entries.text: What’s his problem? He’s been all bent out of\nshape since yesterday.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_11

entries.text: I don’t know... He spent the evening in his room\nwithout so much as a bite of dinner.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_gfather_05

entries.text: Must be teen angst or something. It happens![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_12

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]It woulda been hard to get stuff done with Kiki
clinging to you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Guess
things
worked
out
in
our
favor![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_13

entries.text: The Crystal Pool’s at the top of Oni Mountain.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_14

entries.text: I’m usually not too keen on outsiders heading\nup the mountain, but I think we can make an\r\nexception for you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_15

entries.text: What say you and I go for a hike to find\nourselves a Crystal Cluster?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_sister_16

entries.text: The Pokémon around the Crystal Pool are strong.\nYou be careful out there.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0290_gfather_06

entries.text: You already found all three signs?! Me and\nCarmine only just made it to one!
entries.label: sdc01_0290_student1_01

entries.text: Is Kieran upset about something? I said hi, but I\ndon’t think he even noticed me...
entries.label: sdc01_0290_student2_01

entries.text: I wish I could spend all my time at the festival!\nBut I guess I need to work on the assignment...
entries.label: sdc01_0290_student3_01
